It's important to note that the definition of mental illness was never meant to be based entirely on objective fact. A mental illness is "is a mental or behavioral pattern or anomaly that causes either suffering or an impaired ability to function in ordinary life (disability), and which is not developmentally or socially normative."

Gender identity issues do fit the definition. Trans-people actively seek professional help for their issues. The real issue, which is missed by most of trans and anti-trans activists is how much of the cure is medical and how much is psycho-social.

There is standard consoling, medicine, and even implementing virtual reality to expose and normalize the patient to heights.
